description: One file's details: id, uuid, slug, name, size, type, url, has_thumbnail, created_at, downloads and views. The API has no download endpoint: a file is shared as its page, https://filester.me/d/<slug>, which the url field gives.

id.description: The file: its slug (as in filester.me/d/<slug>), its UUID, or its numeric id

name: get_file
title: File details
